text: dsh-guardian 是面向 DSH 的会话状态守护插件，通过监听 session/event 事件并向 system prompt 注入动态提醒，持续跟踪断言计数、编辑审查队列和代码修改后的反馈环。它会识别助手消息中的未经验证断言，记录成功的文件编辑以便后续复核，并在连续修改却未运行命令时提醒建立反馈环；状态按会话保存，并提供快照服务供界面读取。适合希望在 DSH 会话中获得持续过程提醒的开发者。需要宿主提供 storage 与 systemPrompt 服务，状态默认保存在本机 DSH 存储目录。

dsh-guardian monitors DSH sessions with system prompt reminders. It tracks unsupported claims, queues edited files for review, and warns about repeated edits without command runs. A snapshot service exposes session state. The host provides storage and systemPrompt; state defaults to local storage.
想让 DSH 在回答时提醒我核实没有依据的断言。
DSH 能不能统计助手连续做出否定判断的次数？
修改文件之后经常忘记复查，有办法列出待检查的文件吗？
让 DSH 检测连续改代码却没有运行命令的情况。
我想把会话中的提醒状态按不同 session 分开保存。
能在界面侧读取当前会话的监测状态和待审查队列吗？
Can DSH remind me to verify unsupported claims before answering?
I want a queue of files that were edited and still need review.
dsh-guardian 的功能「断言计数提醒」：扫描助手消息中的断言表达并按轮次累计，连续无断言时逐步衰减。每轮结算后，系统提示会根据计数等级注入相应提醒。
dsh-guardian 的功能「待审查编辑队列」：成功的 write 或 edit 工具调用会把文件路径加入队列，同一会话同一文件去重并按 FIFO 上限淘汰。提示会列出当前会话尚待复核的文件。
dsh-guardian 的功能「无反馈环警告」：每轮统计文件编辑和 bash 或 pwsh 调用，连续达到配置阈值的编辑无执行轮次后，在系统提示中提醒先建立测试反馈环。

@max-null/dsh-guardian README · @max-null/dsh-guardian：This plugin belongs to the **`@max-null/*` family** — a set of plugins that together form the **[SSID (思灵 · Seek Soul in Darkness)](https://github.com/Max-Null/seek-soul-in-darkness)** desktop experience.

Guardian state engine for the DeepSeek Harness — three trigger-line monitors
over session events, with live reminder injection and a UI snapshot service.

M2 of SSiD (思灵), ported from fractal's guardian: assertion counting, the
edit review queue, and no-feedback-loop monitoring.

@max-null/dsh-guardian README · What it monitors：| Trigger line | Rule |
|---|---|
| Assertion count | Scans assistant messages for unverified claims (`不支持/做不到/只有 N 种/不存在/无法 X/远低于/过于 X`). Counts per session, decays by 1 every 3 clean turns, segments into levels [1,3]+. |
| Edit review queue | Successful `write`/`edit` tool calls enqueue `{filePath, sessionId, turn}`. FIFO cap 20, dedup per file+session. The review reminder re-lists them at each prompt assembly. |
| No-feedback loop | Per turn: edits without `bash`/`pwsh` increment the counter; any exec resets it. 3 consecutive edit-only turns inject a "build a feedback loop first" warning. |

  name: '@max-null/dsh-guardian'
```

Requires `storage`, `system-prompt` in the host composition (dsh-base ships
both). Installs as a bundle: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add @max-null/dsh-guardian`.

@max-null/dsh-guardian README · Services：- `ctx.guardian` — the engine:
  - `snapshot()` → `{ session, reviewQueue }` for UI panels
  - `sessionState(sessionId)` → per-session state
- Three dynamic `systemPrompt.context` reminders (`guardian:assertion`,
  `guardian:no-feedback`, `guardian:review`), evaluated per assembly from the
  most recently active session.

@max-null/dsh-guardian README · Config：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `decayTurns` | `3` | Clean turns before one assertion point decays |
| `assertionThresholds` | `[1, 3]` | Ascending thresholds segmenting levels 1-3 |
| `noFeedbackThreshold` | `3` | Consecutive edit-only turns before the warning |
| `reviewQueueMax` | `20` | Review queue FIFO cap |
| `globalRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/storages/guardian` | JSON storage root |

@max-null/dsh-guardian README · Storage：One JSON unit (`guardian`, version 1) under `$DSH_HOME/storages/guardian`:
`sessions` table (per-session state) + the global slot (review queue).
In-memory is authoritative during a run; the session state flushes at turn end
and the review queue on each accepted edit.

@max-null/dsh-guardian README · Storage：A failed flush is logged to stderr and dropped: the serialized write chain stays
usable, and neither the event entry point nor the chain lets a failure escape into
the host process. The state is advisory and rebuildable, so losing one update is the
intended blast radius — a rejected write must never take the kernel down.

@max-null/dsh-guardian README · Develop：```sh
npm install --legacy-peer-deps   # @deepseek-ai/* types come from these devDependencies
npm test                         # vitest: 31 tests (incl. write-failure resilience)
npm run typecheck                # tsc against the installed @deepseek-ai/* types
npm run build                    # emit dist/

@max-null/dsh-guardian README · Develop：> Dev tooling resolves `@deepseek-ai/*` types from the copies `devDependencies`
> installs into `node_modules`. The `paths` entries in `tsconfig.json` point at an
> adjacent `deepseek-harness` checkout, which does not exist beside
> `max-null-plugins/`, so TypeScript falls back to `node_modules` for every one of
> them. Runtime peer resolution is unaffected — the host composition supplies the
> real packages.
